title: The fleet: four clusters made from one definition
design_ref: Why several clusters, and how to cut them; The architecture at a glance
purpose: Show a hub and three workers created from one Terraform definition, on the same Kubernetes minor version, running the same pinned Kueue, with the hub connected to every worker and no GPU capacity running at rest.

checks.description: all four clusters are ACTIVE on the same Kubernetes version
checks.because: One Terraform resource, written once, creates all four clusters, so they cannot differ in version.

checks.description: the cluster role labels are manager, cpu-worker (x2) and gpu-worker
checks.because: Each cluster carries the role it was created for. The platform layer reads it to decide what to install.

checks.description: every cluster runs the same Kueue version
checks.because: A single pinned chart version is installed on every cluster by the same Terraform module.

checks.description: the hub is connected to all three workers
checks.because: The hub holds one kubeconfig Secret per worker, each with a narrowly scoped identity, and MultiKueue reports each connection Active.

checks.description: no GPU node is running at rest (GPU capacity is bought only when a queued job needs it)
checks.because: GPU NodePools start empty. Nodes are created only for pods that Kueue has admitted.

checks.description: the hub has no node pool for user work
checks.because: The hub only has the platform's built-in pool. Team capacity lives in the workers.
